title: Kakutani from Brouwer via Approximate Selections (2 sorries)

problemStatement.formal: Complete 2 sorries in SchauderFixedPointOQ03OQ01.lean: prove approx_selection_exists (existence of ε-approximate continuous selections for set-valued maps via partitions of unity) to derive Kakutani's fixed point theorem from Brouwer's theorem
problemStatement.plain: Kakutani's fixed point theorem (1941): every upper semicontinuous set-valued map from a compact convex set to itself (with nonempty convex values) has a fixed point. The proof reduces to Brouwer via ε-approximate selections. The file has 2 sorries in the approximate selection existence proof, which requires partitions of unity.
whyMatters: Closes 2 sorries in SchauderFixedPointOQ03OQ01.lean extending the Schauder gallery entry
Kakutani's theorem is foundational in game theory (Nash equilibrium) and economics
Partitions of unity approach is standard and well-supported by Mathlib
